svg.text: All equipment owned by the Province of British

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Columbia must be marked with the provincial

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: signature and unit number on both sides. The wide

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: variety of equipment designs makes it impractical

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: to designate a single location or size of marking.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Guidelines for the placing of markings on equip-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: ment are therefore a matter of common sense.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Markings should be placed where they will suffer

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: as little wear as possible and be conspicuous.
